statement: Every Florida profit corporation (and registered foreign corporation) files an annual report with the Division of Corporations between January 1 and May 1 each year after the year of formation or qualification, with a $150 report fee; after the May 1 deadline a $400 late fee is assessed (a $550 total on the fee schedule), and an entity that still has not filed by the third Friday in September faces administrative dissolution.
caveat: The Division states there is no provision to waive the late fee; nonprofit reports are $61.25 with different consequences, and reinstatement after dissolution costs $600 plus each missed year's report fee. dos.fl.gov 403s plain non-browser clients, so verification used a standard browser user agent.
